scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm run workspace:links && pnpm run build:dev-deps
scripts.hmr:prompt: pnpm exec pluxel hmr prompt --root ../../.. --config packages/plugins/host/pluxel.hmr.jsonc --profile plugins-host
scripts.hmr:doctor: pnpm exec pluxel hmr doctor --root ../../.. --config packages/plugins/host/pluxel.hmr.jsonc --profile plugins-host
scripts.hmr:builtin: pnpm exec pluxel hmr builtin --root ../../.. --config packages/plugins/host/pluxel.hmr.jsonc --profile plugins-host
scripts.hmr:smoke: sh -c 'pnpm run dev:prepare && timeout -k 2s 25s node scripts/hmr-start.mjs; s=$?; test $s -eq 124 -o $s -eq 143'
scripts.deploy:prepare: pnpm run workspace:links && pnpm run build:deploy-deps && pnpm run ensure:builtin-dists
scripts.deploy:managed:smoke: pnpm run deploy:prepare && node scripts/smoke-http-host.mjs managed
scripts.deploy:frozen:smoke: pnpm run deploy:frozen:build && node scripts/smoke-http-host.mjs frozen
